author: Insta360
description:
Creator @es_dons headed into the wilderness with his friends for a month, armed with the new Insta360 X6. The result? Some of the sickest 360 footage to date.
From waterfalls and backflips to campfires and base jumping, X6 is built to capture every adventure from every angle.

X6 features:
✅ Flagship 1-inch 8K 360 imaging with custom dual Sony square sensors
✅ 8K50fps 360 video, 120MP 360 photos, and 5K60fps or 4K120fps single-lens
✅ Upgraded Triple AI chip system for better noise reduction and low-light shots
✅ Flat 4K straight from the camera with InstaFrame 2.0 tracking
✅ Support for POV Head Tracker and new Foldable Selfie Stick
✅ 10-bit color, I-Log, and native Dolby Vision, a first in 360
✅ Zero Editing with AI Director and Auto Edit 2.0, plus Moments Pro in the cloud
✅ 140 minutes of 8K30fps recording, no overheating
✅ 2.32" OLED, Full Screen Press, Replaceable Lens 2.0
✅ 360 windproof mic and a Hidden Engine Mic for riders

See more: 🔗 https://bit.ly/x6_store_ytb
